title: Delegating Real-World Tasks
subtitle: A playbook for AI agents that hand work to human assistants
description: A playbook for AI agents that hand real-world tasks to human assistants: how to write a request that works, spending limits and approvals, identity and access, privacy, confirmation and receipts, what to do when it fails, when to hand back to the person, with a request format, an approval log and a pre-send checklist.

title: Hiring and Working with a Concierge
subtitle: A buyer's guide to personal concierge, errand and assistant services
description: A buyer's guide to personal concierge, errand and assistant services: what a concierge is, how services charge, eleven questions to ask before hiring, trust and safety habits, how to ask clearly, hiring for an older parent, what to do when something goes wrong, plus a request template and a comparison table. Opens with a quick reference for AI agents: what to ask the person first, a request they can fill in, how to compare totals and the stop signs.

title: Traveling with an Older Parent
subtitle: A practical guide for the person who plans the trip
description: A practical guide for the person who plans a trip with an older parent: what to ask the doctor, how to arrange airport assistance, medicine and documents, packing, arrival, where to stay, what to do when something goes wrong, plus a master checklist, a medical information card and an itinerary to share. Opens with a quick reference for AI agents: what to ask the person first, the order of work, a trip record they can fill in and the stop signs.

title: Visiting Puerto Rico
subtitle: A practical guide for visitors, and for the people who help them
description: A practical planning guide for visitors to Puerto Rico and the people who help them: the basics, getting there and around, weather and hurricane season, the island in six parts, planning for travelers who need more support, safety, a flexible five-day plan, a packing list and questions for your lodging. Opens with a quick reference for AI agents: what to ask the person first, the safe facts, the facts to check and the planning rules.
